request.prompt:
HUD element sheet for a 4-player top-down party brawler, every element laid out separately in a clean grid on a plain neutral mid-grey background, each with a small plain grey caption under it. Draw exactly these elements and nothing else, all text exactly as quoted (Russian):

1. Match timer: big bold white "1:27" with a dark outline. Caption "таймер".
2. Final-seconds timer: big bold red "0:07", slightly larger, and under it a smaller bold red "ФИНАЛ!". Caption "финал".
3. A row of four score tiles side by side, left to right: red 3, blue 23, yellow 1, purple 0. Each tile is a dark semi-transparent rectangular plate with a thin vertical colour strip on its left edge and the number in that player's colour; the blue tile (the leader) has a white frame; the red tile has a small white "ТЫ" in its top-left corner. Caption "счёт, рамка лидера".
4. One line of light-green bold text: "Круг скоро переедет — следующий уже отмечен на газоне". Caption "подсказка круга".
5. Two floating popups in the player's colour: blue "+1 в круге" (smaller) and yellow "ВЫБИЛ! +10" (bigger). Caption "всплывающие".
6. Two red leash segments side by side, straight lines: a slack one — thin and dark red; a taut one — thick and light red, almost pinkish-white, with an outline. Caption "поводок: слабый / натянутый".
7. Duel panel: a white round clock "0:42", under it a big round score "1 : 0", under it a small light-grey "Раунд 2"; next to it two health bars, each a dark plate with a coloured fill — a red bar three-quarters full and a blue bar one-third full; and a big yellow banner "Нокаут!". Caption "дуэль".

No icons, no portraits, no buttons, no minimap, no extra panels or words beyond the quoted ones.

Style direction «Sunday comic»: chunky bold rounded comic lettering with a thick dark-navy outline instead of a thin shadow; plates flat and solid with a dark-navy outline and slightly rounded corners, two-step flat fills, no gradients, no glow; palette bright and flat, saturated player colours (red, blue, yellow, purple).
request.name: hud
